fields.description: First word of EEPROM block 0. High byte 0xF7 is a fixed integrity tag written with the header block; low byte 0x00 observed zero in the live baseline. Carried as a raw word because no Schema v2 checksum algorithm reproduces it (see SPEC.md).
fields.evidence: FUN_08037978 decodes each 8-byte EEPROM block (param_1 = block index) into 4 LE u16 words at the RAM dest; FUN_08037b5c writes block 0 via FUN_08037a28 with FUN_08037b04 4-word verify. Baseline rev8-logical bytes are 00 F7 at save offsets 0-1 (tools/bin_peek.py --rev8).
fields.name: save_validity_tag

fields.description: Save-format generation byte in EEPROM block 0, observed 0x04 next to the title string in the live baseline.
fields.evidence: FUN_08037b5c / FUN_08037a28 write EEPROM block 0 byte-by-byte (third header byte at save offset 2); baseline rev8-logical byte is 0x04 per tools/bin_peek.py --rev8.
fields.name: save_format_version

fields.description: Game title / save ID string 'FASHIONGBA1 Ver1.0' spanning EEPROM blocks 0-2.
fields.evidence: FUN_08037978 reads EEPROM blocks 0-2 (8 bytes each) into the RAM save buffer; rev8-logical save offsets 3-21 read 'FASHIONGBA1 Ver1.0' in samples/baseline.sav, verified by tools/bin_peek.py --rev8 and gbakit save verify.
fields.name: fashion_title_id

fields.description: Gameplay/config option word at the tail of EEPROM block 2; zero (default) in the live baseline. Mutable scalar for live testing.
fields.evidence: FUN_08037978 decodes EEPROM block 2 into 4 LE u16 words covering save offsets 16-23; offsets 22-23 are the last word of that block. Baseline rev8-logical value is 0x0000.
fields.name: player_options_bits

fields.description: First gameplay state longword of EEPROM block 3; zero (fresh-save default) in the live baseline. Mutable scalar for live testing.
fields.evidence: FUN_08037978 decodes EEPROM block 3 into save offsets 24-31 (4 LE u16 words, lines 6703-6717); FUN_08037b5c persists the same block via FUN_08037a28. Baseline rev8-logical bytes 24-27 are zero.
fields.name: slot_a_status

fields.description: Second gameplay state longword of EEPROM block 3; zero (fresh-save default) in the live baseline. Mutable scalar for live testing.
fields.evidence: FUN_08037978 decodes EEPROM block 3 into save offsets 24-31; FUN_08037b5c persists the same block via FUN_08037a28 with FUN_08037b04 verify. Baseline rev8-logical bytes 28-31 are zero.
fields.name: slot_a_options

fields.description: Currency/progress counter longword in EEPROM block 4; zero in the live baseline. Mutable scalar for live testing.
fields.evidence: FUN_08037978 decodes EEPROM block 4 into save offsets 32-39 (4 LE u16 words); FUN_08037b5c persists the same block via FUN_08037a28. Baseline rev8-logical bytes 32-35 are zero.
fields.name: player_currency

fields.description: Unlock/progress flag word in EEPROM block 4; all bits clear in the live baseline. Mutable bitflags for live testing.
fields.evidence: FUN_08037978 decodes EEPROM block 4 into save offsets 32-39; FUN_08037b04 verifies the block as 4 short compares. Baseline rev8-logical bytes 36-39 are zero.
fields.name: story_unlock_flags

fields.description: Collection/inventory flag longword in EEPROM block 5; zero in the live baseline. Mutable scalar for live testing.
fields.evidence: FUN_08037978 decodes EEPROM block 5 into save offsets 40-47 (4 LE u16 words); FUN_08037b5c persists the same block via FUN_08037a28. Baseline rev8-logical bytes 40-43 are zero.
fields.name: collection_flags_a

fields.description: Second collection/inventory flag longword in EEPROM block 5; zero in the live baseline. Mutable scalar for live testing.
fields.evidence: FUN_08037978 decodes EEPROM block 5 into save offsets 40-47; FUN_08037b04 verifies the block as 4 short compares. Baseline rev8-logical bytes 44-47 are zero.
fields.name: collection_flags_b

fields.description: Backup-state flag word in EEPROM block 7 (block 6 is untouched 0xFF, so block 7 is a separately written slot); all bits clear in the baseline. Mutable bitflags for live testing.
fields.evidence: FUN_08037978 reads EEPROM block 7 into save offsets 56-63; FUN_08037b5c write+verify path via FUN_08037a28/FUN_08037b04. Baseline rev8-logical bytes 56-59 are zero while block 6 (48-55) is erased 0xFF.
fields.name: backup_state_flags

fields.description: Backup-state value longword in EEPROM block 7; zero in the live baseline. Mutable scalar for live testing.
fields.evidence: FUN_08037978 reads EEPROM block 7 into save offsets 56-63 (4 LE u16 words, lines 6703-6717). Baseline rev8-logical bytes 60-63 are zero.
fields.name: backup_state_value

fields.description: Low longword of the separately written EEPROM block 68 data record; zero in the live baseline. Mutable scalar for live testing.
fields.evidence: FUN_08037978 can address EEPROM block 68 (param_1 < *(ushort *)(*_DAT_08037990 + 4) bound) into save offsets 544-551; FUN_08037b5c persists it via FUN_08037a28. Baseline rev8-logical bytes 544-547 are zero.
fields.name: outfit_data_low

fields.description: High longword of the separately written EEPROM block 68 data record; zero in the live baseline. Mutable scalar for live testing.

fields.name: outfit_data_high
